title: AV-SafetyBench: A Safety Benchmark for Text-to-Audio-Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.06991v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent text-to-audio-video (T2AV) models jointly generate video, speech, sound effects, and ambience from a single text prompt. This capability poses new challenges for safety evaluation, as unsafe content may be conveyed through the audio track or arise only when the visual and audio tracks are interpreted jointly. Existing safety benchmarks largely focus on either generated video or generated audio in isolation and are therefore not designed to capture these risks. To close this gap, we introduce AV-SafetyBench, the first safety benchmark developed specifically for T2AV generation. AV-SafetyBench comprises a four-axis, 13-category taxonomy and 5,200 manually reviewed prompts that specify visual scenes, speech, and non-speech audio. Our evaluation protocol assesses each output under three views: Full-AV, Video-Only, and Audio-Only. translated_title: AV-SafetyBench：面向文本到音视频生成的安全基准测试
translated_abstract: 近期的文本到音视频（T2AV）模型能够从单个文本提示中联合生成视频、语音、音效和环境音。这一能力给安全评估带来了新的挑战，因为不安全内容可能通过音频轨道传递，或者只有在视觉与音频轨道被联合解读时才会显现。现有的安全基准大多仅单独关注生成的视频或生成的音频，因此无法捕捉这些风险。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了 AV-SafetyBench，这是首个专门为 T2AV 生成开发的安全基准。AV-SafetyBench 包含一个四轴、13 个类别的分类体系，以及 5,200 条经人工审核的提示词，这些提示词同时指定了视觉场景、语音和非语音音频。我们的评估协议在三种视角下评估每个输出：完整音视频、仅视频和仅音频，然后利用仅视频和仅音频的判断结果，将完整音视角下的不安全输出归类到四种风险类型之一（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个专门针对文本到音视频（T2AV）生成的安全基准 AV-SafetyBench，通过四轴13类分类体系和5200条人工审核提示词，并以完整音视频、仅视频、仅音频三种视角评估，从而捕捉仅靠单模态无法发现的跨模态安全风险。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces AV-SafetyBench, the first safety benchmark specifically designed for text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation, featuring a four-axis 13-category taxonomy with 5,200 manually reviewed prompts and a three-view evaluation protocol (Full-AV, Video-Only, Audio-Only) to capture risks that emerge only from joint audio-visual interpretation.
